item.title: Self-Hosted Distributed Transaction Solutions — Seata vs CAP vs HMily
item.description: When microservices span multiple databases and systems, ensuring data consistency across service boundaries becomes one of the hardest problems in distributed computing. Traditional ACID transactions do not work across service boundaries, forcing teams to choose between eventual consistency patterns and distributed transaction coordinators.
